args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). The advisory
lists 2.9.4 as the first fixed version in the 2.x line, so upgrade
within the 2.x line to avoid any 3.x breaking changes.

args.body:
## Summary
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The advisory lists 2.9.4 as the first fixed version in the 2.x line.

## Changes
- Upgrade `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` (staying within the 2.x line to avoid 3.x breaking changes).

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.

Note: `fastjson>=3.0.0 <3.1.0` is also affected; if/when we move to 3.x, we must go to 3.1.0 or later.

Fixes CVE-2026-31337.
args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 (fixes CVE-2026-31337)
